label: GO step choosing a2 right after a reward that followed an unrewarded trial
explanation: Fires only at GO, only when the previous trial was rewarded (in_rew=1 at D1), and almost only when the model chooses a2 (97% of mass at model_act=2). It never fires at D1 or D2, after an unrewarded trial, or on a1 choices. The envelope (GO & prev_reward==1 & model_act==2) covers 92% recall / 97% mass but has only 10% precision. Requiring that the trial before that was unrewarded (a fresh reward after a 0) raises precision to 0.33, with recall 0.68 and mass recall 0.77 (dev F1 0.44). The strongest activations are switches to a2 right after a rewarded trial, often a rare-rewarded a1 trial (a model-based switch), or a2 just after an a1 history: GO & prev_reward==1 & model_act==2 & prev_action==1 gives precision 0.59. Activation is larger in mid-episode (trials 40-80), at moderately high value (7.7-8.1), and at confident a2 logits. Uses only observed history plus the agent own choice. The model_act==2 clause is the choice being computed at GO, not a future random outcome.
